questions.question: Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. Covered with a material or substance in order to stop heat, sound etc. from entering or escaping
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

Covered with a material or substance in order to stop heat, sound etc. from entering or escaping
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Insulated'.

Key Points

  • Let us explore the given options:-
    • 'Hydrated' means caused to absorb water.
      • Example: The bicyclists must be hydrated frequently.
    • 'Insulated' means protected by interposing material that prevents the loss of heat or the intrusion of sound.
      • Example: Many houses in the north are warm in winter because they are insulated so that the heat is not lost.
    • 'Assimilated' means absorb and integrate (people, ideas, or culture) into a wider society or culture.
      • Example: Immigrants have been successfully assimilated into the community.
    • 'Calibrated' means carefully assessed, set, or adjusted.
      • Example: These sensors should be systematically calibrated and checked for accurate signal outputs.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. Flesh eating animal

questions.question: Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. Something like an opening, particularly one in the body such as a nostril

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:
